statement: OpenShell and A2A remain under active qualification. Source changes, integration, runtime preflight, cancellation/recovery checks and evidence retention are in progress. Full operational acceptance remains incomplete.

reference_sources.public_payload_scope: Public derived architecture/control explanation; original PPTX payload not included by this revision

a2a_scope: Route- and image-specific tests exist; complete fleet and three-route banking acceptance remain incomplete. A source test or successful handoff on one image does not qualify all routes.
openshell_scope: Native qualification and its acceptance/rollback evidence remain incomplete. Existing source or CPU checks do not establish operational acceptance.
banking_scope: The reviewed accepted record contains0/3 genuine completed frozen banking results. SDK qualification with zero model starts is not a banking result. Task ownership, startup and recovery acceptance require fresh proof before execution.
current_edition_publication: Source revision, build validation, published generation, actual served bytes and operational acceptance are distinct. Each published edition requires its project-owned immutable generation and a matching served-body receipt; source integration alone does not establish publication or feature acceptance.
project_rule: Each library keeps its own authority repository, publisher and host. Shared catalog entries link outward. The DSH 80-row matrix is a DSH control crosswalk, not acceptance of other projects.
inventory_scope: Exact1d21 exported docs inventory; this successor replaces existing files and regenerates current-state/index pages. Private and historical artifacts remain preserved.
prepared_revision_basis: Metadata-only legacy classification on source6554; all178payload members retained and allbinarybytes unchanged from47. APP_LOGIN_MAIN_TEST_EN.pptx is retained legacy/notcurrent; canonical J/K/L and two foundation SVGs govern current guidance.
control_basis: Original workbook retained privately; reviewed private risk worksheet J1/K1/L1; M1 audit/evidence spans all; CIA is a separate risk-objective axis. PPTX slide2 separates runtime containment from resource authorization.
